name: creations_upload_show
description: Inline upload widget for user-local files (image, SVG, video, audio). No-UI clients use creations_request_upload + creations_finalize_upload instead.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

multiple.description: Default true for image/auto, false for video/audio.
